items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Rosalind Academic Plan for free GPT-Rosalind access in US university labs
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Rosalind 學術計畫，美國大學實驗室可免費使用 GPT-Rosalind
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs at U.S. universities up to 30 free ChatGPT Business Standard seats for up to 12 months. Approved labs can also receive access to GPT-Rosalind, its dedicated life-sciences model that works with the Rosalind Workbench for tool orchestration in chemistry, genomics, and wet-lab tasks. Research data shared under the plan is not used to train OpenAI models by default.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Rosalind 學術計畫，符合資格的美國大學學術實驗室最多可獲得 30 個免費 ChatGPT Business Standard 席次，為期最長 12 個月。核准實驗室還可使用專為生命科學設計的 GPT-Rosalind 模型，並搭配 Rosalind Workbench 進行化學、基因組與濕實驗工具編排。計畫下分享的研究數據預設不會用於訓練 OpenAI 模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands specialized scientific access beyond enterprise customers and signals OpenAI’s interest in academic life-sciences workflows. The trusted-access requirement and U.S.-only scope limit immediate reach; whether labs gain meaningful productivity gains will depend on real usage data that is not yet public.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將專業科學存取從企業客戶擴展到學術界，顯示 OpenAI 對生命科學工作流程的興趣。受信任存取要求與僅限美國的範圍限制了立即影響；實驗室是否真正提升生產力仍待公開使用數據驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan to help more academic scientists access GPT‑Rosalind, our dedicated life sciences model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 Rosalind 學術計畫，協助更多學術科學家存取我們專為生命科學設計的 GPT-Rosalind 模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic and Simons Foundation commit $15M to help mathematicians review AI results
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Simons 基金會投入 1500 萬美元協助數學家審視 AI 成果
items_flat.summary_en: The Simons Foundation announced a $15 million initiative in partnership with OpenAI and Anthropic to support workshops, conferences, and programs that help mathematicians evaluate, understand, and build on AI-generated mathematical results. OpenAI is contributing $5 million and will provide model access and compute to Simons-supported researchers; Anthropic is also providing tools and compute. The foundation will manage awards through an open call for proposals.
items_flat.summary_zh: Simons 基金會宣布與 OpenAI、Anthropic 合作的 1500 萬美元計畫，資助工作坊、會議與專案，協助數學家評估、理解並延伸 AI 生成的數學成果。OpenAI 出資 500 萬美元，並提供模型存取與運算資源給基金會支持的研究者；Anthropic 亦提供工具與運算。基金會將透過公開徵求提案管理資助。
items_flat.analysis_en: The initiative responds to the volume of AI-generated math results OpenAI released earlier in October, shifting focus from generation to verification and community standards. It is unclear how quickly independent verification will scale or whether the funding will meaningfully alter publication and acceptance norms in mathematics.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫回應 OpenAI 十月初發布的大量 AI 生成數學成果，將重點從生成轉向驗證與社群標準。獨立驗證能多快規模化，以及資金是否真正改變數學發表與接受規範，目前仍不明確。
items_flat.quote: As artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes the research landscape, we want to help the mathematical community come together and forge the best path forward.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著人工智慧快速重塑研究格局，我們希望協助數學社群凝聚共識，開闢最佳前行路徑。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic grants METR employee-like access for independent risk evaluation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 給予 METR 近員工級存取權進行獨立風險評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it has onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space, and access to internal tools roughly on par with its own risk-assessment teams. METR will publish analyses of Anthropic’s risk levels, incidents, or practices; Anthropic cannot veto publication but may require redactions in narrow predefined categories such as customer data or model architecture. The company is also working with SecureBio and Accenture and is in early discussions with Hugging Face.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布已讓六名 METR 員工配備公司硬體、辦公室空間，並提供與自身風險評估團隊大致相當的內部工具存取權。METR 將發表對 Anthropic 風險等級、事件或實務的分析；Anthropic 無法否決發表，但可要求在客戶數據或模型架構等預定義狹窄類別進行遮蓋。公司亦與 SecureBio、Accenture 合作，並與 Hugging Face 進行早期討論。
items_flat.analysis_en: Embedding external evaluators with publication rights that Anthropic cannot block is a concrete step toward external accountability after the White House Accord. The practical impact depends on how thoroughly METR can examine safeguards and whether redaction rules leave enough substance for independent scrutiny.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 嵌入外部評估者並給予 Anthropic 無法阻擋的發表權，是白宮協議後邁向外部問責的具體步驟。實際影響取決於 METR 能多深入檢視安全機制，以及遮蓋規則是否仍留下足夠實質內容供獨立審查。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing that we’ve started to give employee-like access to a team from METR, a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布，已開始給予 METR 團隊近員工級的存取權，METR 是評估前沿 AI 模型的非營利組織。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA releases open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models for always-on agents
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 發布開源 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 與 Bolt 模型，面向持續運作代理
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter multimodal model (12B active) built for always-on agentic tasks including instruction following, tool use, multistep workflows, and visual document understanding. It also released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB for local agent workloads that fit in 24 GB of memory; a smaller Bolt E4B 4GB is scheduled for October 23. Super VL and Bolt 74B are available now on Hugging Face with open weights.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是開源的 1200 億參數多模態模型（活躍 120 億），專為持續運作的代理任務設計，涵蓋指令遵循、工具使用、多步驟工作流程與視覺文件理解。同時發布適合 24 GB 記憶體的本地代理模型 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB；更小的 Bolt E4B 4GB 預計 10 月 23 日推出。Super VL 與 Bolt 74B 現已在 Hugging Face 提供開源權重。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open weights that organizations can post-train and run on their own infrastructure address demand for controllable, on-premises agents. Claims of matching larger models at one-fifth the size and 5× throughput need independent verification; the real test will be how well specialized post-trained versions perform versus closed frontier models on production workloads.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可後訓練並在自有基礎設施運行的開源權重，回應了對可控、本地代理的需求。聲稱以五分之一規模匹配更大模型並達到 5 倍吞吐量，仍需獨立驗證；真正考驗在於專業後訓練版本在實際生產工作負載上能否勝過封閉前沿模型。
items_flat.quote: NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: NVIDIA 今日發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是開源的 1200 億參數模型，為專業持續運作代理提供最快任務完成速度與最高準確度。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI rolls out GPT-Live-1.1 with new voices and better accents in ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-Live-1.1，為 ChatGPT 帶來新語音與更好口音
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 and a mini version called GPT-Live-1.1 Quip in ChatGPT Voice, Codex, and dots. The update improves natural accents across languages and adds new voices for French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Mexican Spanish, and an English option called Bubbie. Live also uses a wider range of short phrases while searching.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在 ChatGPT Voice、Codex 與 dots 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 及其迷你版本 GPT-Live-1.1 Quip。此次更新改善多語言自然口音，並新增法語、德語、印地語、日語、韓語、墨西哥西班牙語語音，以及英語選項 Bubbie。Live 在搜尋時也會使用更廣泛的短語提示。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an incremental but practical improvement to real-time voice interaction rather than a new model family. Better multilingual accents and reduced awkward filler phrases matter for adoption outside English-dominant markets, though regional availability and actual latency gains remain to be verified by users.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是即時語音互動的漸進實用改進，而非全新模型系列。更好的多語言口音與減少生硬填充語對非英語市場採用有幫助，但實際延遲改善與地區可用性仍待使用者驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re rolling out GPT‑Live‑1.1 and GPT‑Live‑1.1 Quip, a mini version of the model, in ChatGPT Voice, with more natural accents across languages.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在 ChatGPT Voice 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 及其迷你版本 GPT-Live-1.1 Quip，提供更自然的多語言口音。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens applications for STEM and Conceptual Reasoning Fellowships
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 開放 STEM 與概念推理研究員計畫申請
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic opened applications for two new fellowships. STEM Fellows (science and engineering) and Conceptual Reasoning Fellows (philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law) will spend four months at Anthropic starting January 2027, working to help Claude reason better on hard problems in those fields. The application deadline is October 28.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放兩項新研究員計畫申請。STEM 研究員（科學與工程）與概念推理研究員（哲學、認知科學、經濟學、政策與法律）將從 2027 年 1 月起在 Anthropic 工作四個月，協助 Claude 在這些領域的困難問題上更好推理。申請截止日期為 10 月 28 日。
items_flat.analysis_en: Expanding fellowship tracks beyond core AI-safety engineering to domain reasoning suggests Anthropic wants external expertise to improve Claude’s performance on specialized tasks. Outcomes will depend on how fellows’ work feeds into model improvements and whether results are published.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將研究員計畫從核心 AI 安全工程擴展到領域推理，顯示 Anthropic 希望引入外部專業提升 Claude 在專業任務上的表現。成果取決於研究員工作如何回饋模型改進，以及結果是否公開。
items_flat.quote: Applications are now open for two new Anthropic Fellowships. STEM Fellows ... and Conceptual Reasoning Fellows ... will spend four months at Anthropic from January 2027.
items_flat.quote_zh: 兩項新的 Anthropic 研究員計畫現已開放申請。STEM 研究員與概念推理研究員將從 2027 年 1 月起在 Anthropic 工作四個月。

frontier_other.analysis_zh: 可後訓練並在自有基礎設施運行的開源權重，回應了對可控、本地代理的需求。聲稱以五分之一規模匹配更大模型並達到 5 倍吞吐量，仍需獨立驗證；真正考驗在於專業後訓練版本在實際生產工作負載上能否勝過封閉前沿模型。
frontier_other.quote: NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents.
frontier_other.quote_zh: NVIDIA 今日發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是開源的 1200 億參數模型，為專業持續運作代理提供最快任務完成速度與最高準確度。

brief_en: OpenAI rolled out GPT-Live-1.1 with better multilingual voices and launched the Rosalind Academic Plan for free GPT-Rosalind access in US university labs. Anthropic gave METR employee-like access for independent risk evaluation and opened new STEM and conceptual-reasoning fellowships. NVIDIA released open Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt agent models. OpenAI, Anthropic and the Simons Foundation committed $15M to help mathematicians verify AI-generated results.
brief_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 多語言語音更新，並開放 Rosalind 學術計畫讓美國大學實驗室免費使用 GPT-Rosalind。Anthropic 給予 METR 近員工級存取權進行獨立風險評估，並開放新的 STEM 與概念推理研究員計畫。NVIDIA 發布開源 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 與 Bolt 代理模型。OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Simons 基金會共同投入 1500 萬美元協助數學家驗證 AI 生成成果。
